text:
maria-cs: Hey team — GreenLeaf Health reported they suddenly can't see models in the console and billing shows no org data after yesterday's RBAC refactor. Models list returns 403, embeddings calls 401/DecryptDenied. customer is panicked.
alex-support: Thanks — can you paste exact errors? Any tenant id or sample request id?
maria-cs: Customer tenant: greleaf-prod, sample request id: req_0a9f33b2. Console list request stack: `GET /orgs/greleaf-prod/models 403`.
greenleaf-admin: we also tried the CLI `redwood models list` and got "permission denied". Billing page shows empty project list.
alex-support: Escalating to eng-security and SRE. tagging @reno-engsec @tess-sre
support-bot: Incident INC-2024-3289 created and routed to eng-security. :rotating_light:
reno-engsec: On it. Quick hypothesis: RBAC refactor renamed the runtime service principal from `svc-model-serving@` to `svc-model-runner@` — KMS key bindings might still reference the old principal, causing DecryptDenied. Can you grab a KMS error trace from the customer's failing request?
maria-cs: Pasted from logs: ```
ERROR: google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt denied for resource projects/rdw-prod/locations/us/keyRings/org-keys/cryptoKeys/tenant-greleaf. Permission 'cloudkms.cryptoKeys.decrypt' denied to serviceAccount:svc-model-runner@rdw.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
tess-sre: That aligns. If key IAM binding still points to `svc-model-serving@`, the renamed principal lacks decrypt permission. We need to verify key bindings and the service account mapping created during the refactor.
ida-devops: I can run a backfill to add the new principal, but want to understand why rename didn't update KMS bindings. Was there a migration step that updates KMS policies? @reno-engsec
reno-engsec: Migration was supposed to run config-mapper v2 which patches KMS bindings, but looks like a subset of tenants had custom key aliases and were skipped by the script. greleaf has custom key alias `tenant-greleaf` so it was excluded. Bug: script treated aliases as externals and skipped permissions backfill.
alex-support: ETA on fix? Customer needs read access within the hour if possible.
ida-devops: I'll run a one-off backfill: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding tenant-greleaf --member=serviceAccount:svc-model-runner@rdw.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` against the key ring. Will also verify billing view role on the org.
irma: (reacts :thumbsup: )
ida-devops: Running now... snippet: ```bash
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding tenant-greleaf \
  --location=us --keyring=org-keys --member=serviceAccount:svc-model-runner@rdw.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```
ida-devops: Confirmed binding applied. Also added `roles/viewer` on the billing project to `team-service-account@rdw.iam.gserviceaccount.com` used for billing queries.
greenleaf-admin: Trying again — models listing works! CLI ok, console shows models and billing appears. Thank you.
alex-support: Great. Root cause: RBAC refactor migration skipped tenants with custom KMS aliases. Immediate remediation: one-off backfill for affected tenants. Next steps: patch migration script to handle alias patterns, add integration test and a preflight check that KMS bindings equal expected principals, and run a scan to find other tenants with skipped aliases.
reno-engsec: Filed ENGSEC-472: "KMS binding backfill for alias-handling during role rename". Will schedule patch and test. Also recommend an audit alert when KMS Decrypt failures spike for a tenant.
maria-cs: Customer satisfied and asking for postmortem and assurance this won't repeat. I'll send them a short summary and link to postmortem once done.
tess-sre: Follow-up: add runbook step to detect service-account renames and auto-apply KMS binding updates. Also add a canary run of migration in staging against tenants with custom aliases.
alex-support: Closing incident INC-2024-3289 after confirming customer recovery. Will track follow-ups in ENGSEC-472. :white_check_mark:
